description: Two attenuverters with an offset, each working on its own signal and both polyphonic

params.text: Multiplies the signal on its channel by anything from -3 to +3, so that turning it below the centre inverts the signal
Adds a steady voltage to its channel after the scale knob, -10V to 10V

inputs.text: The signal for this channel; every channel of a polyphonic cable is scaled and offset alike

outputs.text: The signal for this channel scaled and offset, held between -12V and 12V, with as many channels as arrived at the input

notes: a channel is only calculated while a cable is patched to its output.
